concerns.text: T007 requires per-sequence metrics for the control baseline, but the evaluation_results schema's model_type enum only permits 'physics_teacher' and 'neural_teacher'. The task's verification ('metrics exist for every test sequence and model type') is unexecutable for control rows: contract validation in T012 will fail or the rows must be dropped. Either the schema must be extended or T007 must specify how control rows are stored.

The schema makes 'fid' a REQUIRED per-sequence field, but T007 computes FID once per model pair (set-level). An implementer cannot fill a per-sequence fid value; T003's CSV 'with fields matching' the schema and T012's contract tests are therefore unexecutable as written. Specify where set-level FID is written (e.g., a separate aggregate file) or amend the schema.

T002 implements the edge case 'if validation MSE > 0.07 after 20 epochs, switch to a higher learning-rate schedule' while T005 caps training at ≤6 epochs. The 20-epoch trigger can never fire, so the fallback branch is dead code and untestable. Reconcile the epoch counts (spec edge case vs plan T3.2) so the condition is reachable and verifiable.

T003's verification says first_slice_metrics.csv 'contains real measured SSIM/PSNR values for both model types on shared test sequences', but at T003 only the student exists (baselines are trained in T006). The verification is unachievable at its position in the execution order; restrict it to the physics-teacher student or move the comparison to T007.

Tasks reference 'contracts/physics_trajectory.schema.yaml' etc. without a resolvable path: the plan places contracts under specs/002-.../contracts/, while the actual schemas reviewed here live under specs/001-.../contracts/. An implementer cannot deterministically locate the schema files; state the exact repo-relative path in the tasks.

T009 says 'regenerate a defined subset of trajectories per setting' but the subset size is not defined anywhere (no count, no fraction, no config key). Name the concrete subset size or the config parameter that fixes it so the task is deterministic.
